overview: Knowledge base and edge computing resources for low-resource infrastructure and offline-first AI systems.

items.title: Low-Resource Computing
items.description: Strategies and techniques for optimizing performance on legacy hardware and edge devices. Focus on minimal dependencies and maximum efficiency.

items.title: Edge AI Architecture
items.description: Patterns for deploying AI models on resource-constrained environments without cloud dependencies. Offline-first methodology.

items.title: OSINT & Data Analysis
items.description: Open-source intelligence gathering and pattern detection methodologies. Ethical frameworks for data analysis.

items.title: Digital Sovereignty
items.description: Building independent infrastructure. Avoiding cloud lock-in. Community-driven technology ownership.

items.title: Educational Infrastructure
items.description: Open-source tools and frameworks for teaching computational thinking, AI, and systems engineering in resource-limited settings.

items.title: Terminal-First Design
items.description: CLI-driven interfaces that prioritize simplicity and transparency. Unix philosophy applied to modern web development.
